summary: Desktop startup now passes the selected profile to the capture API instead of requesting a fixed 1440p60 ceiling. The plan records API-supported source limits separately from measured output. Profile changes that require a native source restart are rejected without changing the active profile or track, and the user is told to stop and restart explicitly. No capture-quality or capacity result is claimed.

checks.name: macOS capture option source review
checks.observation: The macOS bridge reads requested width/height and mandatory frameRate. It installs the retained long-edge processor for legacy/window capture and passes the selected FPS and long edge to ScreenCaptureKit for supported full-display capture. This confirms accepted configuration inputs, not actual dimensions or cadence.

checks.name: Windows capture option source review
checks.observation: The Windows bridge reads mandatory frameRate and passes it to RTCDesktopCapturer::Start. ParseMediaConstraints reads mandatory/optional maps; top-level width/height do not configure the native source. The plan therefore marks Windows source resolution limiting unsupported and leaves selected resolution enforcement to the existing publisher encoding path.

checks.name: Capture-plan, geometry, and profile-transition Flutter tests
checks.observation: The focused tests cover requested low/high plans, native restart requirements, mobile compatibility, odd portrait/ultrawide geometry, even dimensions, and no upscale. Transition tests assert restart-required requests preserve active profile/track, do not call publisher update, and clear the restart notice after successful stop/start. Flutter is not installed or available on PATH in this worktree host, so the tests could not execute.

checks.name: Dart local import and feature-boundary check
Windows display/window capture and performance profile
checks.observation: No Windows capture device/runtime was available. Actual capture, encoded and presented dimensions/cadence, CPU/GPU cost, frame age, resize/DPI behavior, and sleep/wake recovery remain unmeasured.

checks.name: macOS display/window/fallback capture and performance profile
checks.observation: No macOS device/runtime was available. ScreenCaptureKit, window, and legacy fallback output dimensions/cadence, CPU/GPU cost, frame age, Retina/ultrawide geometry, HDR/SDR handling, and sleep/wake recovery remain unmeasured.

checks.name: Low-to-high-to-low capture restart
checks.observation: ScreenShareCapturePlan reports when a native capture limit changes, but restart is not wired into the live lifecycle. The current controller does not retain the selected source ID/options or expose a selected-source replacement operation; current stop uses the participant screen-share toggle. Do not claim successful restart or consent handling until the #161 owner boundary can replace only the active screen source safely.

remaining: Add selected-source capture replacement and consent-aware restart through the existing #161 lifecycle owner, then run low/high/low and display/window acceptance on Windows and Apple Silicon macOS. Record actual capture/encode/presented cadence, dimensions, CPU/GPU, frame age, geometry, and sleep/wake results from those devices.
